items.source: Helper class that efficiently creates multiple CallableStatementCreator objects with different parameters based on an SQL statement and a single set of parameter declarations.
items.translation: 高效创建多个基于 SQL 语句和一组参数声明的、具有不同参数的 CallableStatementCreator 对象的辅助类。
